_comment: Reference values for ase-script-debug (ASE 3.23.0, EMT, fcc Cu a=3.615 A primitive cell). Deterministic; calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: EMT energies are relative to the equilibrium-crystal reference state, so the magnitude is small by design. 5 oracle runs produced identical values; tolerances are the physical minimum resolution (float print).
